mapper.select: SELECT AuthorId FROM dbo.vw_PublicStory WHERE StoryId = #{storyId}
mapper.update: MERGE dbo.Rating WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS UserId, #{storyId} AS StoryId, CAST(#{score} AS TINYINT) AS Score, #{review, jdbcType=NVARCHAR} AS Review) AS src ON t.UserId = src.UserId AND t.StoryId = src.StoryId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Score = src.Score, Review = src.Review, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UserId, StoryId, Score, Review) VALUES (src.UserId, src.StoryId, src.Score, src.Review);
mapper.delete: DELETE dbo.Rating WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND StoryId = #{storyId}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.StoryId, r.Score, r.Review, r.CreatedAt, r.UpdatedAt, u.UserId AS User_UserId, u.Username AS User_Username, u.AvatarUrl AS User_AvatarUrl FROM dbo.Rating r JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = r.UserId
WHERE r.StoryId = #{storyId} AND r.Review IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.UpdatedAt DESC, r.UserId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT r.Score, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM dbo.Rating r WHERE r.StoryId = #{storyId} GROUP BY r.Score
SELECT RatingAvg, RatingCount FROM dbo.Story WHERE StoryId = #{storyId}
